WPT|/rc.kicker: Waterproofing and Restoration · Concrete Technology · Retrospective concrete waterproofing
WPT|/rc.title: Retrospective concrete waterproofing
WPT|/rc.sub: Crystalline waterproofing: the active ingredients grow into the concrete and seal it from within.
WPT|/rc.intro: The rapid mortar {F20} stops the running water, the crystalline repair mortar {IM} fills chased cracks and forms the coves, and the crystalline slurry {IC} is brushed into the matt damp concrete in two coats: its active ingredients penetrate the capillaries, react with the moisture and the free lime and fill the pores with crystals. Watertight against pressing water from the rear, vapour permeable, suitable for drinking water, permanently active — from the inside, without excavation.
WPT|/rc.photoCap: System build-up: leak plugged, cracks and cove made good, two coats of the crystalline slurry, kept damp — the crystals grow into the concrete.
